title: MxAgile UI Parity Verification
description: Multi-dimensional parity verification result for a UI page or component. Produced by UI-Agent Verify mode. See .mxagile/policies/ui-parity.md for the full contract. AGGREGATION RULE: overall_result=PASS only when all REQUIRED dimensions are PASS. Any FAILED, PARTIAL, or NOT_VERIFIED required dimension causes overall_result=FAIL.

page_id.description: Matches the page_id from the UI inventory (PAGE-...).

scenario_id.description: Optional: the SCN-... identifier of the verification scenario that produced this parity record. Links to planning/scenarios/<scenario-id>.yaml. See schemas/verification-scenario.schema.json.

verified_at.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when this verification was performed.

target_changed_at.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the active acceptance target last changed. When this is more recent than verified_at, the record is STALE and requires re-verification.

evidence_level.description: Evidence level of this verification. browser=Playwright against running app (authoritative); model=mxcli inspect only; static=document analysis; legacy=migrated from a pre-dimensional parity record.

target_mockup.description: Path to the ACTIVE acceptance target mockup used for this verification. May differ from the original source_mockup if the target was refined. See policies/mockup-lifecycle.md.

source_mockup.description: Path to the original (immutable) source mockup as provided by the project/customer. Never modified.

app_url.description: Application URL used during Playwright verification.

role.description: Role used for this verification session (e.g., Admin, SalesUser).

dimensions.description: Independently recorded parity dimensions. Each dimension is evaluated separately. See ui-parity.md for evidence requirements per dimension.

overall_result.description: Aggregated result across all required dimensions. PASS: all required dimensions are PASS. FAIL: one or more required dimensions are FAILED. PARTIAL: one or more required dimensions are PARTIAL or CONFLICT and none are FAILED. NOT_VERIFIED: no browser verification has been performed. STALE: was PASS but active target has changed since verified_at — must re-verify before claiming PASS.

regression_scenario.description: Optional: used to record the expected outcome of a known regression scenario to prove that false-positive prevention works.

schema_version.description: Version of this parity schema. Increment when the dimension set changes. Used for evidence upgrade detection.

parity_dimension.description: Result for one parity dimension. required=true dimensions that are FAILED, PARTIAL, or NOT_VERIFIED prevent overall PASS.

result.description: PASS: dimension satisfies the contract. FAIL: concrete deviation found. PARTIAL: some aspects pass, others have minor issues. NOT_VERIFIED: not yet checked. CONFLICT: evidence contradicts requirements. NOT_APPLICABLE: dimension not relevant (rationale required). LEGACY_EVIDENCE: migrated from pre-dimensional record; provenance preserved but not re-verified. STALE: was PASS but active target has changed since verification — re-verify before claiming PASS.

not_applicable_rationale.description: Required when result=NOT_APPLICABLE. Explains why this dimension is genuinely not applicable for this screen/component.

required.description: When true: FAIL, PARTIAL, or NOT_VERIFIED in this dimension blocks overall PASS.

evidence.description: Specific evidence items supporting this dimension result.

deviations.description: Recorded deviations for FAIL or PARTIAL results.

note.description: Optional human-readable note about this dimension result.

legacy_provenance.description: When result=LEGACY_EVIDENCE: describes the original contract semantics and what was verified under the old schema.

type.description: Type of evidence. dom_text=browser DOM text extraction; dom_selector=element found/not found; navigation_flow=verified page transition.

path.description: Path to screenshot or artifact, if applicable.

concern.description: Short identifier for the concern area (e.g., sidebar_label_grouping, button_caption, column_header).

severity.description: material=affects the UI contract (blocks PASS). minor=acceptable variation.

dimension.description: The dimension this deviation belongs to.

evidence_upgrade_state.description: Tracks upgrade progress when an existing parity record is being migrated to the dimensional schema. Used for resumable evidence upgrade per policies/ui-parity.md.

schema_upgraded.description: True when the record has been structurally migrated to the dimensional schema.

reconstructed_dimensions.description: Dimensions populated from existing authoritative evidence (no re-verification needed).

gaps.description: Dimensions that require re-verification because existing evidence does not cover them.

targeted_reverification_required.description: True when one or more dimensions in 'gaps' require a targeted browser verification run.

reverification_completed.description: True when all targeted re-verification scenarios have been executed.

remaining_scenarios.description: Non-secret identifiers of verification scenarios not yet executed.
